packets.population: Published mixed-cancer overdue-abnormal-screening-result cohort; majority CRC, not a young symptomatic cohort
packets.question: Which process component improves follow-up compared with which actual alternative?
packets.interpretation: Package and component effects are distinct; preserve uncertainty and do not add overlapping effects or infer mortality benefit.

packets.population: Australian primary-care patients selected by abnormal blood results; not CRC-only
packets.question: What does an imprecise adjusted CDS result establish about earlier recognition and follow-up?
packets.interpretation: Benefit not established; crude difference is not adjusted effect; neither equivalence nor universal CDS failure follows.

packets.population: Guideline-defined suspected endometriosis with actual persistence/referral criteria assessed
packets.question: Does normal examination or ultrasound justify discarding persistent warning-sign evidence?
packets.interpretation: A normal test does not exclude the condition; apply actual referral criteria and do not automatically recommend diagnosis or surgery.

packets.population: Persistent unexplained synovitis with specified clinical urgency criteria
packets.question: Can normal inflammatory markers or negative RF/anti-CCP override indicated specialist referral?
packets.interpretation: Qualifying clinical signs and urgency criteria remain relevant; do not extend the rule to all fatigue or aches.
